flags.message: gemini-baseline, codex-baseline, and claude-baseline each freeze context.band=baseline under sal-v3 for Term 2026. The committed metrics/statpack.md salience-band table is headed sal-v4. As required for a frozen-band version mismatch, all three evaluations omit segment_base_rate and brier_skill_score and leave base_rate_basis null; no terminal substitution or re-banding was used. Correctness and Brier scores remain computable. Each evaluation.md explains the omission.
